wargearItems.name: Shimmershield
effects: The bearer's unit gains the following abilities while the bearer is on the battlefield:
Increase Toughness characteristic by 3 against Ranged attacks.
Increase Wounds characteristic of models in the unit by 1
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer's unit gains the following abilities while the bearer is on the battlefield:

  • Increase Toughness characteristic by 3 against Ranged attacks.
  • Increase Wounds characteristic of models in the unit by 1
  • Gain the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability

wargearItems.name: Scattershield
effects: The bearer increases its Wounds characteristic by 3 and gains the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The bearer increases its Wounds characteristic by 3 and gains the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability.

wargearItems.name: Jetbike
effects: Gain the Mounted, Fly, Hover and Deep Strike abilities
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
• Increase Movement characteristic to 14"
  • Increase Toughness characteristic by 2
  • Increase Wounds characteristic by 2
  • Gain the Mounted, Fly, Hover and Deep Strike abilities

wargearItems.name: Twin-linked
effects: For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1
The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Weapon gains the Twin-linked ability:

  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1

The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.

catalogItems.name: Path of Baharoth
effects: Baharoth's Descent: While this model is leading a unit with the Jump Pack ability, models in that unit may Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves during the first Battle Round. Additionally, if this model and a unit it is leading uses the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves Action during the second Battle Round onwards, they can be placed 6" away from enemy models, instead of the typical 9".
This model can lead the following additional unit: Swooping Hawks.

catalogItems.name: Path of Drastanta
effects: Drastanta's Cunning: While this model is Mounted and is leading a Mounted unit, models in that unit increase their Initiative by 3 (instead of 1) when making Melee attacks as part of a Charge and Fight action. Further, this model and the unit it is leading can use the Fall Back Action immediately after using a Charge and Fight action.
This model can only lead the following units: Shining Spears, Windriders.
